arxiv-1710-05361.title: A note on p λ p^{\lambda} -convex set in a complete Riemannian manifold
arxiv-1710-05361.creator: 1 Absos Ali Shaikh, 2 Chandan Kumar Mondal and 3 Akhlad Iqbal
arxiv-1710-05361.description: Abstract . In this paper we have generalized the notion of λ \lambda -radial contraction in complete Riemannian manifold and developed the concept of p λ p^{\lambda} -convex function. We have also given a counter example proving the fact that in general λ \lambda -radial contraction of a geodesic is not necessarily a geodesic.

arxiv-2207-08915.title: Generalized class polynomials
arxiv-2207-08915.creator: Marc Houben, Marco Streng
arxiv-2207-08915.description: Abstract . The Hilbert class polynomial has as roots the j j -invariants of elliptic curves whose endomorphism ring is a given imaginary quadratic order. It can be used to compute elliptic curves over finite fields with a prescribed number of points.

arxiv-2505-13473.title: A Graphical Interface for Category Theory Proofs in Coq
arxiv-2505-13473.creator: Luc Chabassier
arxiv-2505-13473.description: Abstract The importance of category theory in recent developments in both mathematics and in computer science cannot be overstated. However, its abstract nature makes it difficult to understand at first. Graphical languages have been developed to help manage this abstraction, but they have not been used in proof assistants, most of which are text-based.

arxiv-2509-09896.title: Improved Quantum Lifting by Coherent Measure-and-Reprogram
arxiv-2509-09896.creator: Alexandru Cojocaru, Juan Garay, Qipeng Liu, Fang Song
arxiv-2509-09896.description: Abstract We give a tighter lifting theorem for security games in the quantum random oracle model. At the core of our main result lies a novel measure-and-reprogram framework that we call coherent reprogramming . This framework gives a tighter lifting theorem for query complexity problems, that only requires purely classical reasoning.

arxiv-2512-23517.title: Van der Waals interaction at short and long distances: a pedagogical path from stationary to time-dependent perturbation theory
arxiv-2512-23517.creator: L. Saba, C. D. Fosco
arxiv-2512-23517.description: Abstract The van der Waals interaction between neutral atoms is typically studied using stationary perturbation theory for the short-distance (London) limit, while long-distance (Casimir-Polder) results are usually derived via semiclassical, time-dependent approaches. In this pedagogical article, we demonstrate that reformulating stationary perturbation theory calculations in terms of time-ordered correlation functions significantly simplifies the mathematical treatment.

arxiv-2601-10358.title: PLGC: Pseudo-Labeled Graph Condensation
arxiv-2601-10358.creator: Jay Nandy jayjaynandy@gmail.com, Arnab Kumar Mondal arnabkumarmondal123@gmail.com, Anuj Rathore anuj.rathore@fujitsu.com, Mahesh Chandran mahesh.chandran@fujitsu.com
arxiv-2601-10358.description: Abstract Large graph datasets make training graph neural networks (GNNs) computationally costly. Graph condensation methods address this by generating small synthetic graphs that approximate the original data. However, existing approaches rely on clean, supervised labels, which limits their reliability when labels are scarce, noisy, or inconsistent.

pmc-12468136.title: Prevention and Management of Perioperative Acute Kidney Injury: A Narrative Review
pmc-12468136.creator: Mary O’Dell Duplechin, Garrett T Folds, Drake P Duplechin, Shahab Ahmadzadeh, Sarah H Myers, Sahar Shekoohi, Alan D Kaye, Charat Thongprayoon
pmc-12468136.description: Acute kidney injury is a common complication in the perioperative setting, especially among patients undergoing high-risk surgeries such as cardiac, abdominal, or orthopedic procedures. Characterized by a sudden decline in renal function, perioperative acute kidney injury is typically diagnosed based on rising serum creatinine or reduced urine output.

They occur in approximately 1 per 10,000 to 30,000 individuals per year, primarily affecting adults between 30 and 50 years of age.

pmc-13349304.title: Time to recovery from Obstetric Fistula and its predictors among patients admitted to Hamlin Fistula Center, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia: A survival analysis
pmc-13349304.creator: Hayat Ibrahim Oumer, Delelegn Yilma Gebremichael, Gizachew Abdissa Bulto, Sarah Jose, Sarah Jose, Rahul Gajbhiye, Sarah Jose, Rahul Gajbhiye, Emma Campbell, Sarah Jose, Rahul Gajbhiye, Emma Campbell, Julia Robinson
pmc-13349304.description: Obstetric Fistula (OBF) remains a devastating maternal condition in Ethiopia, causing significant physical suffering, social isolation and psychological traumas among affected women. Despite its burden, only a limited number of healthcare facilities in Ethiopia provide surgical interventions. Furthermore, there is a scarcity of evidence regarding the time to recovery from OBF and its predictors in treatment centers.

pmc-13587511.title: Early-life serum protein profiles associated with bronchopulmonary dysplasia in extremely preterm infants
pmc-13587511.creator: Susanna Klevebro, Mohit B. Panwar, Dirk Wackernagel, Ingrid Hansen Pupp, Sophia Björkander, Hanna Danielsson, Mathias Uhlén, Liv Vallin, Karin Sävman, Aldina Pivodic, Ann Hellström, Anders K. Nilsson
pmc-13587511.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundBronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD) affects the most immature preterm infants and can result in long term pulmonary morbidity. Yet, how prenatal and neonatal exposures perturb early proteome maturation and contribute to BPD pathogenesis remains unclear.MethodsIn a cohort of 176 extremely preterm infants (born < 28 weeks gestational age) previously enrolled in a multicenter randomized trial, 825 longitudinal serum samples were collected the first five postnatal weeks.

uslaw-usc-t12-s2293.title: 12 U.S.C. § 2293 — Budget and audit provisions of Government corporation control law applicable
uslaw-usc-t12-s2293.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t12-s2293.description: United States Code, Title 12 (Banks And Banking); Chapter 24 (Federal Financing Bank). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The budget and audit provisions of chapter 91 of title 31 shall be applicable to the Federal Financing Bank in the same manner as they are applied to the wholly owned Government corporations named in section 9101(3) of title 31.
